images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished landscape 3:2 ending illustration for the original medieval religious fantasy game SAINT SEVEN. Input reference 1 is Hormasset: long abundant golden blonde curls, green eyes, ivory/olive gathered long dress, brown shepherd cloak, brown lace-up boots. Reference 2 is Seven: very long wavy silver-white hair, blue eyes, black thin choker, pale icy blue off-shoulder puff sleeve long dress, dark lace-up shoes. Reference 3 is Eli: short wavy blonde hair, dark olive high-collared clerical robe with gold embroidered crosses, ivory-and-gold stole and sleeves, cross pendant. Preserve their exact facial identity, apparent age, hair, eyes, outfit and slender proportions from the provided character references. Their relationship is protective and non-romantic. No redesign. No lamb in this scene. A polished hand-painted 2D classical fantasy illustration with fine ink contour and softly glazed painting, restrained medieval religious painting light and texture, muted dark olive/ivory/aged gold with cool stone, richly illustrated yet clear composition. Not a pixel map, not a screenshot or UI, no text, no logo, no frame, no halos or newly invented magic, no modern items, no copying any existing game art or composition. Characters must be readable when displayed contained within a landscape game viewport. Scene: the still aftermath of Seven's ritual execution in the existing stone church, not the act of violence. Seven lies motionless on the low altar platform in her recognizable pale blue gown, silver-white hair spread softly beside her closed eyes; body intact with no visible injury or blood. In the foreground Hormasset stands alive alone in three-quarter profile, her golden curls and brown cloak catching a narrow cold window light; one hand hangs uncertainly at her side. Her grief is quiet, not theatrical. Far behind the altar, Eli and a few indistinct villagers remain small and solemn. The empty space between Hormasset and Seven is the focus. Subdued candles, receding church benches, grey stone arches, the hush after a ceremony. This is a tragic ordinary ending, not salvation proven and not happiness. Wide balanced landscape composition, figures primarily center-left and center-right, no cropped heads or feet.
